name: BCT inviter contracts unprotected transfer helpers

classification.summary: BCT's inviter contracts expose unprotected transfer helpers (selectors 0x4e515153 and 0xf986351d) and buy(), letting the attacker shuffle BCT between attacker-created inviters, skim the pair and sell into the distorted reserves.
